title: Fair results from a bag
notes: First routes: keep K-1 P1-3, as on guide p2; grades 2-3 use P1-2 before comparing bags in P3-4; grades 4-5 use P1-2 before generalizing the rule in P3. On return, K-1 can change bags or build no-output stories (P4-6). Grades 2-3 can choose efficiency (P4), changing bags (P5), or stopping/skip claims (P6-7). Grades 4-5 can separate skip optimality (P4), unequal draw mechanisms (P5), and no-replacement/stopping questions (P6-7). Keep the ordered-pair record and the chosen/random distinction visible.
